name: Pip breathes
brief: Pip, an orange mouse with big pink ears in a round glass space helmet, a white spacesuit with grey boots and gloves, a red-and-silver air tank on his back, a long red scarf flying behind him and a thin orange tail; standing still facing right, breathing calmly, full body
note: Pip standing: a slow breath (the body and helmet rise a pixel, the arms ease out a little), 4 frames at 6 fps, looping.

keys.label: in
keys.action: standing, breathed in: the chest and helmet a pixel higher, the arms a little out from the body
